mediaCard.$description: Corner radius of the featured media card (BR-12). TBD-10: "rounded" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Outline stroke width of the featured media card, and of the line between its thumbnail and its text (BR-13).

bg.$description: Fill of the featured media card: the pure black page (BR-03). The card is separated from the page by its outline, not by a surface color (C-05). It does not read color.surface.card until TBD-06 is resolved.

highlight.$description: The neon highlight of the featured media card: its outline is brand pink, like the standard card (BR-01, BR-12, ADR-0018, ADR-0026).

divider.$description: Color of the line between the thumbnail and the text of the featured media card: brand pink, like the outline (ADR-0018, ADR-0026).

fg.$description: Title text of the featured media card.

color.$description: Focus ring color of the linked featured media card (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009). The ring surrounds the whole card.

width.$description: Focus ring width of the linked featured media card (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between the linked featured media card and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of the linked featured media card (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
